title: What is Preview
summary: Preview is a fast document and image viewer for Linux and Windows with annotation and editing tools.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text: Preview opens PDF documents and standard image formats without delay. You can view, mark up, crop, and convert files.

sections.heading: Supported Formats
sections.text: Preview reads PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP, TIFF, BMP, and GIF files. It also exports to PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP, and TIFF.

steps: Open any supported PDF or image file.
Use the top toolbar to navigate, zoom, or search.
Click the Markup button to add drawings, text, or signatures.
note: Preview preserves your original file until you choose to save or export changes.
